run_precompute_enumerate_surface: run the CLI script to enumerate and pickle surface structures for a bulk crystal index
build_enumerate_surfaces_for_saving: build a function to enumerate symmetrically distinct slab surfaces from a bulk ASE Atoms object
create_standardize_bulk: create a function that standardizes a bulk unit cell to its conventional standard structure
test_is_structure_invertible: test whether a pymatgen Structure has z-direction symmetry that makes top and bottom equivalent
refactor_flip_struct: refactor a pymatgen Structure by flipping it upside down along the z-axis for surface analysis
